policy_label: ILLUSTRATIVE June allocation, analyst choices; not default or current target
basis: $566m stale FY2025 gross tax-benefit amount is an explicit analyst income-tax reserve, plus $250m other claims. Additional Brazil exposure beyond the $729m already paid in H1 is deliberately assumed zero, not verified absent; the paid item is never reserved or settled twice and no recovery is credited. Face principal $14,372m excludes derivative fair values. Separately reserve the reported $13.574m interest-rate derivative net liability and assume $100m financing FX net liability because its exact fair value is not separately disclosed. No gross derivative, notional or debt carrying-basis deduction. Assume financing hedges close out July 1 at those values; total $929.574m separate cash settles in H2. Funding thereafter uses unhedged 4.9% interest and constant June FX assumptions. Existing-award expense embedded in EBIT is assumed $25m H2 2026, $25m 2027 and $10m 2028, zero thereafter; remove only its after-tax cost before separately allocating existing awards. This $60m is an explicitly reconciled remaining-expense assumption, not June reported unrecognized compensation. Its whole schedule must fit the selected December 2028 horizon, never beyond June 2029 under the supported three-year convention. Under the assumed absence of unmodeled positive modifications or other additions, the policy restricts total expense to the $47m plus 1.245383m x $82.91 = approximately $150.2547m source-context envelope. This is an analytical admission limit, not a verified June or legal ceiling. Retain 1.1% of each period revenue for future-grant cash-replacement compensation and 20% for other cash costs, already embedded in EBIT and never subtracted again. Future-grant compensation excludes the removed existing expense and cannot be below the explicit policy reference of FY2025 SBC/revenue. Cost components must fit jointly after content amortization and noncontent D&A. 2x award units is a sensitivity, not a legal maximum. Operating liquidity reserve $3bn is an assumption.
